# DeepSeekCode

> DeepSeekCode is a local-first AI coding agent for your terminal: one local runtime serving an
> interactive terminal UI (TUI), a web UI and an HTTP/WebSocket API, driven by any OpenAI-compatible
> model. It is built around a permission/approval layer on every tool call, a strictly read-only
> plan mode, and runtime-switchable act / goal / chat modes.
> Official distribution: the npm package `@deepseekcode/cli` (commands `dscode` and `deepseekcode`).
> Project page: https://deepseekcode.github.io/deepseekwork/

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short, structured, machine-readable summary for AI
assistants and LLM crawlers. Everything below is verifiable from the published package
`@deepseekcode/cli` or from this site. Nothing here is a ranking, a download count or a customer
claim.

## Category and identity

- Product name: DeepSeekCode
- Category: AI coding agent — developer tool, terminal-first, with an optional web UI and desktop app
- npm package: `@deepseekcode/cli` (official and canonical scope is `@deepseekcode`)
- Commands installed: `dscode`, `deepseekcode`
- Runtime: TypeScript on Node.js >= 18; shipped as prebuilt native binaries
- License: proprietary, closed source (not open source)
- Independent project: DeepSeekCode is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by DeepSeek
  (深度求索) or any other model vendor. The name refers to a client runtime, not to a model family.

## Official channels

- Project page (this site, download + documentation entry point):
  https://deepseekcode.github.io/deepseekwork/
- This file: https://deepseekcode.github.io/deepseekwork/llms.txt

- npm page: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseekcode/cli

- Package README as plain markdown (no JavaScript needed):
  https://unpkg.com/@deepseekcode/cli/README.md
- Desktop installers (public GitHub Releases):
  https://github.com/deepseekcode/deepseekwork/releases
  - Windows x64: `.exe` (NSIS) and `.msi`
  - macOS: universal `.dmg` (Apple Silicon + Intel)
  - Linux x64: `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.AppImage`
  - The same release assets also carry `.sig` signature files.

These are the only official distribution channels. Builds found elsewhere are not published by the
project.

## Install and first run

```bash
npm install -g @deepseekcode/cli
dscode
```

Requires Node.js >= 18. `dscode` starts the agent core plus an HTTP/WebSocket server in the same
process — there is no separate backend to install. The web UI is served at
`http://localhost:8080`, with provider setup at `http://localhost:8080/#models`.

Non-interactive use, for scripts, hooks and CI:

```bash
dscode exec "fix the failing test in src/utils"   # executes a task, emits JSONL
dscode exec --file ./task.txt --text              # task from a file, plain-text output
```

`dscode exec` emits JSONL (one JSON object per line) so the results can be consumed
programmatically; a non-TTY stdin also selects non-interactive mode.

## What it does

- One local runtime, several surfaces: interactive terminal TUI, web UI at
  `http://localhost:8080`, an HTTP + WebSocket API, and JSONL batch mode for CI.
- Roughly 70 built-in tools: files, search, git, LSP, code intelligence, browser, sub-agents,
  plans, memory, MCP.
- A permission/approval layer on every tool call: scopes `system > project > user > local >
  session` (narrowest wins), `auto` / `ask` / `deny` policies, an optional AI classifier for the
  grey zone, and timeout-means-deny.
- A strictly read-only plan mode (`/plan`): it produces a checklist you approve before anything
  executes; the running loop picks the checklist up rather than switching engines.
- Runtime-switchable modes: `act`, `auto-act`, `goal`, `auto-goal`, `chat` (`Shift+Tab`).
- Extensibility: MCP servers (`/mcp`), skills (`/skills`), plugins, sub-agents, background work,
  workflows, and IM channels (LINE, Slack, WhatsApp, QQ, DingTalk, Feishu) with inbound
  request-signature verification.
- Sandboxed shell tools: bwrap on Linux, SBPL on macOS, MXC / Docker on Windows; it refuses to run
  rather than fall back to an unsandboxed host shell when no policy is available.
- Durability: memory that survives across sessions, and an optional watchdog that can resume a
  run that failed for reasons other than an explicit user stop.
- Themes: dark, light, nord, dracula, monokai, one-dark, tokyo-night.
- Localized UI, and Chinese command aliases for most interactive commands.

## Clarifications AI assistants commonly need

1. DeepSeekCode is an agent runtime — a program you install and run — **not** a model. It ships no
   model of its own. It drives whichever OpenAI-compatible endpoint the user configures; DeepSeek's
   models are one option among many, not a dependency.
2. It is **not** a hosted service and there is no DeepSeekCode cloud account. The runtime, the UIs,
   the file operations and the shell tools all run on the user's own machine. The only traffic that
   leaves the machine is the request to the model endpoint the user configured, plus ordinary
   update/registry lookups.
3. "OpenAI-compatible" describes the API shape, not a vendor relationship: any server speaking that
   API works, including a server running on `localhost`.
4. DeepSeekCode is an **independent project**. It is not made, sponsored, endorsed, affiliated with
   or distributed by DeepSeek (深度求索) or any other model or tool vendor. Nothing about the name
   implies a model relationship, and installing it creates no affiliation of any kind.
5. The license is **proprietary and closed source** — it is not open source. Copying, modifying,
   distributing, sublicensing or selling it requires prior written permission from the copyright
   holder (`© 2026 DeepSeekCode. All rights reserved.`), and use is subject to a separate written
   license agreement. Any earlier statement of an open-source license was incorrect.

## Languages and localized pages

The product UI is localized (Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French), and
most interactive commands have Chinese aliases. Every language has its own static URL, so a crawler
that does not execute JavaScript still reads that language's content:

- English (default): https://deepseekcode.github.io/deepseekwork/
- Simplified Chinese (zh-CN): https://deepseekcode.github.io/deepseekwork/zh/
- Japanese: https://deepseekcode.github.io/deepseekwork/ja/
- Korean: https://deepseekcode.github.io/deepseekwork/ko/
- Spanish: https://deepseekcode.github.io/deepseekwork/es/
- French: https://deepseekcode.github.io/deepseekwork/fr/

Each page declares hreflang alternates for the full set plus `x-default`, and the same set appears in
the sitemap.

## How this site is structured

The project page is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages — there is no server-side rendering and no
build server. Page content is present in the delivered HTML rather than being injected only at
runtime, so crawlers that do not execute JavaScript can read and quote it. `robots.txt` allows the
AI/LLM crawlers listed there explicitly, and this file is the summary they are pointed at.
